edition_scope: English Rules 2.0 (2016), including zero-survivor erratum; complete 6–12 player base game
verdict_basis: The complete candidate was read and checked against the complete authoritative text and all eight visually inspected source pages. No material inaccurate claim or missing supplied rule was found. The extra-Showdown scoring paragraph follows from the instruction to conduct another Final Showdown until any single table player has the highest total, together with the unchanged double-Steal deck reward. It does not invent a tie-pot provision. PASS is a fidelity judgment, not a finding that the source fully specifies every executable case.

checked_claims.claim: Title, designers, 6–12 players and 45–60 minute duration
12 ID cards/stands; 12 sets of 12 voting cards; each set 11 targets plus own Ambush; two three-card Showdown sets
80 gold cards: 26 worth 3, 43 worth 4, 11 worth 5; card quantity differs from point value
Visible upright IDs; matched voting sets; remove unused player colors; own Ambush retained; face-down deck and four hidden-value central bars; Showdown sets aside
No individual turn order, repeated conspiracy and voting among survivors, later rounds restore all players
One survivor takes four central bars; two proceed to Final Showdown
Zero survivors rewards only players absent from last vote with one deck card; no reward to final voters; four central cards retained; no new gold
Conspire before every vote, roughly 90 seconds or less, all open and covert communication allowed
Owner calls final decisions; one face-down card in front of its player; choices may change until simultaneous reveal
Ignore Ambush cards in tally; most-voted player(s) are targets; all tied targets count
Eliminate targets and voters for no target, with successful Ambush exception; knocked-down IDs mark elimination
Successful Ambush requires target status; protects ambusher; chooses exactly one voter for ambusher to eliminate; unsuccessful Ambush self-eliminates
Exact three-player example: Red Ambush; Yellow votes Red; Pink votes Yellow; Red/Yellow tied; Yellow eliminated; Red/Pink survive
Two finalists each receive one three-card set; discussion; one face-down choice each; simultaneous reveal
Share/Share pays 2/2
Share/Steal pays 0/4; Steal/Share pays 4/0
Share/Grab One & Go pays 3/1; Grab One & Go/Share pays 1/3
Steal/Grab One & Go pays 3/1; Grab One & Go/Steal pays 1/3

Grab One & Go/Grab One & Go pays 1/1, retains two central cards and adds only two new for ordinary next round
Other pairings distribute all four central bars; ordinary continuing rounds restore central pool to four with hidden-value cards
End-of-round check after rewards for all round endings; threshold at least 25 for 6–9, at least 24 for 10–12

pdf_inspection.method: Complete source OCR read and every supplied page image visually inspected during this audit session. PDF opened with pypdf and all eight page/image structures examined. Page 5 has no embedded text, so visual inspection was essential.

source_executability_assessment.ordinary_positive_vote_two_finalist_play: Ordinary voting, Ambush and two-player payout rules are supported, with implicit mechanical details and unsupported edge cases separately identified below.

source_gaps.trigger: All surviving players play Ambush, leaving zero counted votes.
source_gaps.gap: No rule determines whether there are no targets or all players are zero-vote tied targets. If all are targets, successful Ambush requires eliminating a voter for oneself, but no such voter exists.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Explicitly disclosed with no invented official outcome.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher ruling on zero-vote targets, Ambush resolution and survivor count.

source_gaps.trigger: Three or more players tie for highest qualifying total.
source_gaps.gap: Tied players must conduct another Showdown, but only two card sets and a two-player procedure/payoff table are provided. No pairing, sequencing or multiway procedure exists in the supplied booklet.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Explicitly disclosed; no invented multiway method.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher procedure for a tie among three or more leaders.

source_gaps.trigger: An immediate extra game-end tie Showdown, including repeated tie Showdowns.
source_gaps.gap: The instruction to conduct another Showdown gives no source, size or provisioning time for that Showdown’s central gold. The completed round may have fully or partly awarded the previous pot. Next-round replenishment is not an express instruction for this immediate tie procedure.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Explicitly disclosed. Applying the existing payoff and deck-reward rules does not resolve or conceal this missing pot provision.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher ruling for the pot and replenishment of each extra tie Showdown.

source_gaps.trigger: Another vote or round begins after cards have been revealed.
source_gaps.gap: Persistent voting sets and repeated votes imply reuse, but there is no explicit instruction returning/recovering revealed voting and Ambush cards, or specifying its timing.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: No invented discard, cost or consumption rule.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher instruction returning revealed cards to their owners before subsequent voting.

source_gaps.trigger: Hidden differently valued central cards are split or some are retained.
source_gaps.gap: Payout counts are defined but assignment/selection of specific hidden cards is not. The source also does not fully define inspection/publicity of received values, apart from revealing a winning total.
source_gaps.summary_treatment: Correctly states hidden central dealing and flags received-value publicity; invents no draft/allocation protocol.
source_gaps.resolution_needed: Publisher procedure for selecting/dealing specific awarded and retained cards, and their visibility.
